structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page never told me in shekels what the עו"ש costs me, and its big 74,044 ₪ figure with "דמי ניהול 0" made leaving the money there look fine. The only lead I got is "קרן כספית", and next I'd tap "כסף שיושב בעו״ש" in the menu.

findings.what: The headline 74,044 ₪ assumes 5% a year on a current account, which makes the עו"ש look like it grows. It contradicts the page's own line that it often pays no interest
The cost is never given in shekels, only 'לפי התעריפון'
Alternatives (קרן כספית, פיקדונות, מק״מ) are only mentioned in passing, with no numbers and no next step

findings.what: The chart lines have no labels next to them
The calculator starts at 10,000 ₪, not my amount, and offers no monthly saving view I could easily use
Technical codes (BANK-20, TXI OQ11) and 'חסום' lock labels are confusing
